'''''The River Queen''''' is a riverboat that travels the [[River Mora]] and the [[River Erinin]].<!---RIVER!!!--->

The River Serpent is one of the ships that brings the Amyrlin and party to Shienar and then returns them to [[Tar Valon]]. The ships are docked at [[Medo]] where [[Nynaeve]] and [[Egwene]] board.{{ref/book|2|12}}. Egwene and Nynaeve receive lessons on the way.{{ref/book|2|18}}
